servinfo.title: Air Cleaner Assembly Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Disconnect air cleaner suction hose No.2 (1).
Disconnect MAF sensor with IAT sensor-1 connector (2) from MAF sensor with IAT sensor-1 as follows.

s2.ptxt: Move connector lock pin (4) in arrow direction as shown in figure.
Push connector lock lever (5) and disconnect connector from MAF sensor with IAT sensor-1.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect engine harness clamp from air cleaner assembly.
Disconnect waste gate control hose No.3 (6) from air cleaner assembly (3).
Loosen air cleaner outlet hose No.2 clamp (7), and then remove air cleaner assembly.
Remove air cleaner suction hose No.2 (1) and resonator (2) with air cleaner outlet hoses, if necessary.

attention4.ptxt: Turbocharger compressor impeller will be damaged if any foreign material enters through turbocharger inlet air pipe.
Take special care not to allow any foreign material enter turbocharger compressor housing during removal and installation.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Tighten air cleaner outlet hose clamp(s) to specified torque.
Insert protrusions (1) of air cleaner assembly (2) into grommets (3) on intake manifold.
